text: A precedent and citation WDAG accounting system documents and traces every adjustment to a federated learning model, and that full accounting is what enables dynamic feedback effects and the rapid integration of new techniques.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607

isBasedOn.name: How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance

abstract: This setup enables fully accounted dynamic feedback effects for rapid integration of new techniques and approaches to FL. This, in turn, ensures that the models remain cutting-edge and are quickly adaptable to new challenges and opportunities in AI development.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: governance of iteratively updated federated learning models
